description.value: The BCR Museum Society has operated this regimental museum since 1982, preserving the history of the BC Regiment (Duke of Connaught's Own) through uniforms on mannequins, World War One and Two weapons displays, and artefacts from the 6th Duke of Connaught's Own Rifles era. Run entirely by dedicated volunteers, the collection includes items on long-term loan alongside pieces owned outright by the society. It sits within the historic Beatty Street Drill Hall, one of Vancouver's oldest military landmarks.
